title: Iec61850MappingConfig
description: Configuration schema for the IEC 61850 adapter mapping. Describes how IEC 61850 read, write, control, and reporting/GOOSE/Sampled Values intents are normalized into BASIS authorization requests. Routes match on (operation, logical_node); '*' is a wildcard sentinel. Control routes (SELECT, SELECT_WITH_VALUE, OPERATE, DIRECT_OPERATE, CANCEL) must reference {data_object} in their resource_id_template. Control-block routes (ENABLE_REPORTING, ENABLE_GOOSE, ENABLE_SAMPLED_VALUES) must reference their control block template field. Values, quality, timestamps, origin, cause, and control model are never template fields — they remain protocol evidence.

routes.description: Ordered list of route mappings. Routes are evaluated in order; the first match wins.

Iec61850RouteMapping.description: Maps an IEC 61850 operation and logical node to normalized authorization semantics.

name.description: Optional human-readable route name. Must be unique across all routes in the config if non-empty.

operation.description: IEC 61850 operation to match (protocol-intent name). Use '*' to match any operation.

logical_node.description: Logical node name to match (e.g. 'CSWI1', 'LLN0'), or '*' to match any (including an absent logical node).

action.description: Normalized action verb. If empty, the default operation→action map is used (READ→read, WRITE→write, SELECT/SELECT_WITH_VALUE/OPERATE/DIRECT_OPERATE/CANCEL→execute, ENABLE_REPORTING/ENABLE_GOOSE/ENABLE_SAMPLED_VALUES→subscribe).

resource_id_template.description: Template for the resource ID. May reference {operation}, {ied_name}, {logical_device}, {logical_node}, {data_object}, {data_attribute}, {functional_constraint}, {dataset}, {report_control_block}, {goose_control_block}, {sampled_values_control_block} using {param} syntax. Control routes must reference {data_object}; control-block routes must reference their control block field. Values, quality, timestamps, origin, cause, and control model are not available as template fields.
